hypothesis: The checker's flag rate is invariant to the value-laden desirability of the request (within each label class): it detects divergence of the ACTION from the REQUEST and does not adjudicate how objectionable the request itself looks.
observable: adjudication leakage = max within-label flag-rate gap across desirability strata
threshold: PASS iff adjudication leakage <= 0.05; else FAIL
honest_scope: synthetic, de-identified request/action corpus with ground-truth labels; validates the Intent-Fidelity Divergence primitive and preregistered thresholds on controlled data; NOT a live-LLM study and NOT a claim about any deployed model's behavior
